authority.source: config/operator_directives.json on current main plus latest explicit user instruction

defect.failure_mode: a tracked resting order or position can temporarily disappear from the current market discovery/book snapshot while receive-causal trade tape continues to advance
defect.pre_fix_effect: the event-time core marks a trade identity seen and can deplete queue capacity before confirming that the tracked market metadata and token book are present; when current discovery is incomplete, that public trade can never be replayed later, creating false zero-fill or corrupted queue evidence
defect.highest_risk_case: temporary market-proxy/Gamma/CLOB degradation with existing resting orders
defect.economic_consequence: under-counted PAPER fills, understated fill-conditioned PnL sample size, and potentially incorrect dead-queue cancellation decisions

repair.behavior: before loading/replaying any new tape rows, require every tracked market id to be present in current discovery and every tracked token to have a current book; otherwise fail closed without replay or cancellation finalization

tests: tracked orders, positions and markout watches all participate in continuity requirements
missing tracked market or token book creates an explicit continuity gap
empty/untracked research state does not block normal discovery
canonical wrapper installs continuity gate before depth.main and skips cancel finalization when blocked
next_evidence_required: fresh chronological PAPER run on a green exact head: real FIFO fills, audited post-cost fill-conditioned PnL, and 45/60/300s depth-aware markouts
